prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site rendered in soft, bleeding hues. On the far left stands a tall crane with a yellow cab, its long arm stretching across the sky. Below it, a worker in a blue hard hat looks up at the machinery. Next to him, a brown dog sits patiently on a pile of gravel. In the center foreground, a foreman in an orange vest points toward a stack of red bricks. A laborer in gray overalls listens intently, holding a clipboard. Behind them, a cement mixer churns slowly, its drum stained with dried concrete. To the right of the mixer, a woman in a white helmet carries a shovel over her shoulder. She walks past a wooden pallet loaded with bags of cement. Near the pallet, a black cat sleeps on a coil of thick rope. Above the scene, two sparrows perch on a hanging wire. In the mid-ground, a bulldozer with muddy treads pushes dirt toward a trench. A driver in a green shirt operates the heavy machine. Beside the trench, a surveyor in a plaid shirt adjusts a tripod-mounted level. Another worker in a yellow jacket kneels nearby, examining a blueprint spread on the ground. A coffee cup rests on the blueprint, steam rising faintly. In the background, a partially built wall of cinder blocks rises unevenly. A ladder leans against this wall, reaching toward the second story. On the top rung, a painter in coveralls dips a brush into a bucket. The bucket hangs from a hook on his belt. Nearby, a wheelbarrow tipped on its side spills sand onto the grass. A child in a red jacket watches from behind a chain-link fence. The child holds a toy truck tightly. A security guard in a navy uniform stands by the gate, checking a watch. A stray pigeon pecks at crumbs near the guard's boots. There is no heavy rain falling on the site. There is no bright sun visible in the sky. There is no finished glass skyscraper in the background.
